items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I went with Vaughan... I was on the road with Vaughan a little bit, about three or four months

ctx.x: I’m talking about 1943 I went with Vaughan and I turned 18 in ‘44 and because I was on the road with Vaughan a little bit, about three or four months, I wasn’t drafted until April. But I got a touch of the band, and I said that’s for me.
So when you anticipated getting out of the service you knew what you wanted to do.
